transcription.doubts: Heading and siglum read 'gls' / 'ls' (lower-case l with slanted top serif, taller than cap height, no i-dot).
proof_notes: heading_de/sigla: 'gis' → 'gls'; text_de: 'G und Is' → 'G und ls' (both lower-case l, no dot; checked at 600 dpi against capital I in 'Ip Hunt', p. xxiii; p. xxvi col. 1)

others.text: Wormald (1999, p. 265) finds Liebermann’s account of the manuscripts of Alfred’s law-book too flawed to reproduce.
